neighbours.label: two unrelated things: Estonia (Tallinn, Tartu, the Estonian language) and Tagalog/Taglish discourse particles ('lang', 'na', 'naman'); Latvia, Lithuania and English filler words stay low
fire: Our tour bus reached Tallinn by noon and parked outside the walls.
Students at the university in Tartu protested the new fees.
Every government form in Estonia can be signed online.
The Estonian choir festival fills a huge open-air stage.
The ferry from Helsinki to Estonia takes two hours.
Grabe, traffic lang talaga today, pero okay na rin.
Sige na, ikaw na bahala sa dinner later.
Ang ganda naman ng view dito, sana all.
quiet: Our tour bus reached Riga by noon and parked outside the walls.
Students at the university in Vilnius protested the new fees.
Every government form in Denmark can be signed online.
The Latvian choir festival fills a huge open-air stage.
The ferry from Helsinki to Stockholm takes all night.
Wow, traffic is just terrible today, but okay anyway.
Fine then, you handle dinner later.
The view here is so pretty, everyone should see it.
